title: CharacterProfile
description: A fully-defined character stored in the Character Forge. Matches the Character model in backend/server.py. Used by the Story Memory engine to keep AI generation consistent.

name.description: Character name (may include alias or title)

personality.description: Personality description — used by AI to maintain consistent characterization
examples: Brave, imaginative, loving, and protective. Sometimes scared but always pushes through for his brother.

appearance.description: Visual appearance description — injected into illustration prompts for consistency
examples: A 5-year-old boy with messy brown hair, bright curious eyes, and rosy cheeks. Wears blue pajamas with stars and a shimmering silver-blue cape.

special_trait.description: A single memorable special quality that defines this character
examples: His love for his baby brother makes his cape glow with golden light

notes.description: Optional illustration or writing notes for contributors
examples: Draw him slightly small compared to furniture to emphasize his bravery despite being little

visual_tags.description: Structured visual attributes for consistent illustration generation

examples: rosy cheeks, small for his age
